title: Teaching Mrs. Tingle
description: With their futures threatened by false accusations of cheating, three teenagers take matters into their own hands.

title: Restoration
description: A hedonistic physician (Robert Downey Jr.) weds the king's (Sam Neill) lover but is not allowed to consummate the marriage in 17th-century England.

title: Escape From Alcatraz
description: A hardened con with a history of prison breaks, is sent to serve the rest of his life sentence at Alcatraz, America's most infamously brutal and inescapable maximum security prison.

title: Jacob's Ladder
description: A Vietnam vet prone to flashbacks walks the edge of sanity as he searches for the cause of his nightmarish visions.

title: Regarding Henry
description: Two bullets force a career-driven Manhattan lawyer (Harrison Ford) to start life over with his loving wife (Annette Bening) and daughter.

title: Event Horizon
description: A spaceship missing for seven years finally re-emerges and sends out a distress signal. But when a team is sent out to investigate, they discover that something sinister has taken over the craft.

title: Blindness
description: A doctor's wife is one of the few individuals immune to a strange epidemic that causes people to lose their eyesight.

title: Days of Thunder
description: An upstart stock-car driver goes to the edge for his manager, his brain-surgeon girlfriend and himself.

title: Marathon Man
description: The CIA and a Nazi death-camp dentist (Laurence Olivier) chase a New York graduate student (Dustin Hoffman).

title: Double Jeopardy
description: In an insurance scam, a man fakes his death and sets his wife up to take the blame. After serving 10 years in prison, she sets out to get revenge, immune from the law since she cannot be re-prosecuted for the same crime.

title: Sliver
description: A book editor (Sharon Stone) has an affair with a voyeur (William Baldwin) in her building, a Manhattan murder scene wired for video.

title: Fatal Attraction
description: A New York lawyer (Michael Douglas) with a wife (Anne Archer) and daughter sleeps with a client (Glenn Close) whose lust turns to hate.

title: Basic Instinct
description: A woman suspected of murdering her lover with an ice pick ensnares a San Francisco cop in a web of lust and deceit.

title: The Ghost and the Darkness
description: An Irish engineer (Val Kilmer) and a U.S. hunter (Michael Douglas) stalk two lions decimating a construction crew in East Africa.

title: Airplane!
description: A pilot (Robert Hays) afraid to fly follows his stewardess ex-girlfriend (Julie Hagerty) and must take over for the poisoned crew.

title: Joe Dirt
description: A goofy janitor (David Spade) tells a radio talk-show host (Dennis Miller) about his search for the parents who abandoned him.

title: Red Eye
description: A plane passenger (Cillian Murphy) forcibly involves his seatmate (Rachel McAdams) in a plot to assassinate a government official.

title: Stardust
description: To win the heart of his beloved, a young man (Charlie Cox) ventures into the realm of fairies to retrieve a fallen star (Claire Danes).

title: Planes, Trains and Automobiles
description: An ad exec and a shower-curtain-ring salesman become co-travelers on the way to Thanksgiving in Chicago.

title: View From the Top
description: A woman (Gwyneth Paltrow) from a small Nevada town makes friends while training to become a flight attendant.

title: The Terminal
description: Unauthorized to enter the United States, an Eastern European (Tom Hanks) befriends a flight attendant (Catherine Zeta-Jones) while living in a New York airport.

title: Shakespeare in Love
description: Young William Shakespeare (Joseph Fiennes) falls for Viola (Gwyneth Paltrow), reawakening his creativity, but she is betrothed to Wessex.

title: What Women Want
description: A freak accident gives a Chicago advertising executive (Mel Gibson) the ability to read women's minds.

title: A Night at the Roxbury
description: Desperate to meet women and open their own dance club, brainless brothers Steve (Will Ferrell) and Doug Butabi (Chris Kattan) cruise Beverly Hills.

title: Up in the Air
description: A corporate downsizing expert (George Clooney) realizes he is developing real feelings for a frequent bedmate (Vera Farmiga) whose cache of travel miles and club cards rivals his own.

title: Coneheads
description: Stranded on Earth, aliens Beldar and Prymaat of Remulak try suburbia with their teenage daughter, Connie.

title: Galaxy Quest
description: Aliens, believing actors to be real heroes, enlist cast members of a sci-fi TV series to help save their people.

title: A Haunted House 2
description: Malcolm (Marlon Wayans) once again finds himself the target of supernatural shenanigans after he, his new girlfriend (Jaime Pressly), and his girlfriend's children move into their dream home.

title: You Can Count on Me
description: The straight-arrow life of a single mother (Laura Linney) begins to go into a tailspin when her drifter brother (Mark Ruffalo) returns home.

title: Yours, Mine & Ours
description: A household threatens to burst at the seams when the marriage of two widowed parents creates a family of 18 children.

title: Grumpier Old Men
description: The wedding of their children and the arrival of a romantic prospect preoccupies bickering Minnesota retirees John (Jack Lemmon) and Max (Walter Matthau).

title: Patriot Games
description: An IRA terrorist vows revenge against the ex-CIA agent who killed the man's brother and thwarted an attack on royalty.

title: The Mexican
description: A bungling gangster (Brad Pitt) must reform to please his girlfriend (Julia Roberts) but still has one last job to fulfill.

title: When Harry Met Sally...
description: Harry and Sally have known each other for years, and are very good friends, but they fear sex would ruin the friendship.

title: The English Patient
description: A Hungarian count's (Ralph Fiennes) fling with a British newlywed leads to tragedy in World War II North Africa.

title: Terms of Endearment
description: A strong-willed woman (Shirley MacLaine) and her equally independent daughter (Debra Winger) keep the lines of communication open as each deals with the curveballs life throws at them.

title: Forrest Gump
description: JFK, LBJ, Vietnam, Watergate and other history unfold through the perspective of an Alabama man (Tom Hanks) with an IQ of 75.

title: You've Got Mail
description: Boutique bookseller Kathleen hates Joe, the owner of a corporate Foxbooks chain store that just moved in across the street. When they meet online, however, they begin an intense and anonymous Internet romance, oblivious of each other's true identity.

title: The First Wives Club
description: Three 50-ish college friends (Goldie Hawn, Bette Midler, Diane Keaton) plot revenge after their husbands dump them for younger women.

title: Failure to Launch
description: The parents of a young man (Matthew McConaughey) who still lives at home hire a beautiful woman (Sarah Jessica Parker) to entice him to finally leave the nest.

title: Faster
description: A veteran cop (Billy Bob Thornton) and an assassin (Oliver Jackson-Cohen) track an ex-convict (Dwayne Johnson) who is on a mission to take revenge on his brother's killers.

title: The Last Airbender
description: A being with the ability to manipulate the four elements joins forces with a waterbender and her brother to restore balance to their war-torn world.

title: Airplane II: The Sequel
description: The first commercial space shuttle sends loony Ted (Robert Hays) and his former girlfriend (Julie Hagerty) on a trip to the moon.

title: Tommy Boy
description: A ne'er-do-well auto-parts heir must stop his father's widow from selling the business.

title: The Wedding Singer
description: A wedding singer loses all hope when he is abandoned at the altar by his fiancée. He meets a young woman named Julia, who enlists his help to plan her wedding. He falls in love with her and must win her over before she gets married.

title: Grumpy Old Men
description: Minnesota neighbors (Jack Lemmon, Walter Matthau) rekindle a 10-year feud when they fall for the same widow (Ann-Margret).

title: Top Gun
description: For Lieutenant Pete "Maverick" Mitchell and his friend and co-pilot Nick "Goose" Bradshaw, being accepted into an elite training school for fighter pilots is a dream come true. But a tragedy will threaten Pete's dreams of becoming an ace pilot.
